name: Jozah (son of Amaziah)
title: Head of the tribe of Simeon
summary: Jozah, son of Amaziah, was one of the heads of the tribe of Simeon. The family grew and sought new grazing land during the reign of King Hezekiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jozah, son of Amaziah, is listed among the heads of the tribe of Simeon.
